sonnet.problem: The card says "if they diligently learn the ways of His people" right after cards 5 and 6 spoke of "the ones He uproots" and "each one," which includes the house of Judah. "They" is never tied to the evil neighbors on this card, so a baker could take it to mean Judah. Card 8 only names the neighbors afterward.
sonnet.rule: "He," "she" and "they" always point to someone the baker can tell.

sonnet.problem: The statement joins two claims with "but": the land is laid waste, and no one takes it to heart. It is also the verse almost word for word, with no context saying whose land or who is speaking.
sonnet.rule: A true or false statement tests one claim.
